newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Sovereign Assurance considers listing this yr.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Sovereign Assurance considers listing this yr.

text.p: New Zealand's Sovereign Assurance Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was considering whether it will seek to become a publicly listed company on the New Zealand Stock Exchange during this calendar year.

"We can confirm that we are actively reviewing the option im consultation with merchant bankers Clavell Capital Ltd and sharebrokers JB Were and Son," Ian Hendry, joint managing director of Sovereign Assurance, said in a statement.
"However, no firm firm decision has been made, nor will be until later in the year."
A public listing would raise Sovereign's public profile and open up new avenues for investment and capital raising, Hendry said.
Sovereign Assurance was formed in 1989 and is involved in both the life insurance and investment markets in New Zealand.
In more recent times, it has moved into home mortgage lending.
Sovereign said that based on current levels of new individual life business it ranked as New Zealand's second largest life insurer, employing 380 people.
